sloka: वाल्मीकिर्भगवान्कर्ता सम्प्राप्तो यज्ञसंविधम् ।येनेदं चरितं तुभ्यमशेषं सम्प्रदर्शितम् ।। ७.९४.२५ ॥
transliteration: vālmīkirbhagavānkartā samprāpto yajñasaṁvidham ।yenedaṁ caritaṁ tubhyamaśeṣaṁ sampradarśitam ।। 7.94.25 ॥

translations.english: The revered Valmiki, the author, has arrived at this sacrificial assembly, and it is by him that this entire story has been revealed to you.
